messages:
kevin: Quick heads-up. Vendor portal shows west-eu A100 pool as fully allocated (600/600) but our internal active count is 548. Anyone pasted a bulk reservation or did an invoice auto-confirm? :eyes:

sara: not from infra. Procurement did open a PO last week for a customer demo warm-up but it was marked 'soft' in our tracker. link: https://git.internal/pr/4890

daniel: I pulled the portal audit. API output: GET /pools/west-eu -> total:600, vendor_allocated:600, vendor_notes:["auto-confirm: true"], active:548, maintenance_pending:["rack-12"]

kevin: auto-confirm? procurement-bot, do we have a rule that auto-confirms POs on invoice upload?

procurement-bot: Policy: if PO has tag "demo-warmup" and invoice uploaded by a known contact, vendor_auto_confirm = true. Last action: PO-10014 tagged demo-warmup by jia on 2026-03-19. Status: invoice-draft(uploaded).

jia: That was me. We wanted quick warm slots for a walkthrough. I didn't realize vendor auto-confirm would flip allocation. Sorry. I can ask vendor to revert to provisional or change tag.

kevin: We try to avoid hard allocations until the day-of. Two things: (A) ask vendor to set PO to provisional (or cancel auto-confirm), (B) ops can check whether rack-12 maintenance is causing the active delta. If vendor keeps allocate we might auto-pay when finance sync runs.

ops-oncall: We're mid rolling kernel/driver swap on rack-12 and rack-13 due to a DP-3 instability patch. Expected impact: 8 GPUs offline for ~90m (started 05:10 UTC). That explains ~52 slot gap. I'll mark maintenance window in portal.

kevin: Good catch. jia, vendor reply?

jia: Vendor support: "We can flip PO to provisional within 45m if requester updates PO status "provisional" in portal." I updated PO-10014 status to provisional. Asked vendor for confirmation.

procurement-bot: Vendor acknowledged change. Allocation sweep scheduled in 18m. Invoice auto-pay blocked until finance webhook receives final invoice. Finance contact: finance-help@redwood.ai

sara: I also turned on a short-term alert: if vendor_allocated - our_active > 40 for > 10m then trigger #eng-infra and notify ops-oncall. Added a dashboard tile and a small runbook note.

kevin: Nice. Once vendor finishes sweep can someone run reconciler and post delta?

daniel: Reconciler run @05:55 UTC -> vendor_allocated:600, holds:[PO-10014 (provisional)], active:548, maintenance: rack-12(ongoing). After ops finished (06:42 UTC) second run: vendor_allocated:548, holds:[], active:548.

kevin: Great. I'll update the demo booking and ping finance to prevent any invoice autopay. Also noted we should patch procurement tagging rules to avoid demo-warmup auto-confirm.

jia: I'll submit a small PR to change tag -> requires manual confirm.

sara: leaving notes in the procurement runbook + added short alert in infra.

kevin: Thanks team. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
